env_vars_service_key_unique.name: env_vars_service_key_unique
env_vars_service_key_unique.where: "env_vars"."service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "env_vars"."environment_id" IS NULL

env_vars_service_environment_key_unique.name: env_vars_service_environment_key_unique
env_vars_service_environment_key_unique.where: "env_vars"."service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "env_vars"."environment_id" IS NOT NULL

env_vars_project_environment_key_unique.name: env_vars_project_environment_key_unique
env_vars_project_environment_key_unique.where: "env_vars"."service_id" IS NULL AND "env_vars"."environment_id" IS NOT NULL

pat_tokens_scope_project_check.name: pat_tokens_scope_project_check
pat_tokens_scope_project_check.value: ("pat_tokens"."scope_kind" = 'org' AND "pat_tokens"."scope_project_id" IS NULL AND "pat_tokens"."scope_service_id" IS NULL) OR ("pat_tokens"."scope_kind" = 'project' AND "pat_tokens"."scope_project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pat_tokens"."scope_service_id" IS NULL) OR ("pat_tokens"."scope_kind" = 'service' AND "pat_tokens"."scope_project_id" IS NULL AND "pat_tokens"."scope_service_id" IS NOT NULL)

project_updates_sources_check.name: project_updates_sources_check
project_updates_sources_check.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("project_updates"."sources") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("project_updates"."sources") BETWEEN 1 AND 20 ELSE false END
